title: Education during the COVID-19 pandemic: Does national culture predict school closures and changes in student performances?
forecast_target: PISA 2022 country performance and 2022 forecast deviations
forecast_origin: Before PISA 2022; country trend uses available waves through 2018
forecast_method: Per-country linear and quadratic trend regressions; nested R-squared/F-test choice; use quadratic only when improvement p<=0.05, otherwise linear
score_scope: Country mean scores by mathematics/science/reading and additional aggregates/percentiles; N=64 forecast-deviation analysis
evidence_strength: Publisher full text; Methods > Student performance and performance trends > Trends and forecasts
decision_rationale: Publisher methods explicitly forecast PISA 2022 from country PISA waves through 2018, satisfying the project's operational future-cycle target definition. Exact eligibility under the original 1,266-record search cannot be determined because its reproducible search and inclusion protocol is unavailable. Do not alter frozen corpus counts.
next_action: Second-reviewer eligibility adjudication after original search scope recovery; retain as external forecasting precedent meanwhile.
